data.name: Tank Squad
data.detailed_description:
Tank Squad is a tactical-combat action game, where you take command of your tank squad and lead it during tank battles of World War II. Take part in historical battles, set in linear campaigns, alone or with up to three friends. Each player can control his own tank or be a part of your tank crew.

Each battle is a separate mission in the campaign, with separate objectives that you need to achieve to win the battle. Plan ahead of your strategy and tactics, use infantry, artillery and air support when it is available. Minimize your losses, to be prepared properly for the final battle of the campaign.

While playing the campaign missions, tanks can be damaged or lost during the battles. Try to pull as many tanks as possible back to the repair station, whether they are your own or your enemies. While the tanks are being repaired, work together to get them back into action faster.

  • Repair damages taken during battle

  • Replenish tank ammo (main gun and machine guns)

  • Refuel vehicles

Manage your squads. Replace the deceased or destroyed units in squads. Create new squads and assign any units from the pool automatically or manually.

Play skirmish or procedural missions with up to 3 friends, use tank radio to communicate and give out orders to coordinate your squad.

Play in either total control mode or multi-crew mode. Other players can join your tank and you play as a crew member rather than controlling the entire tank yourself.

To be successful in battle, this mode requires good communication and coordination as a crew.

Our vehicles are based on construction documents, expert opinions and insights from documentations. Our aim is to provide a realistic gaming experience, whilst making certain simplifications to the mechanics.

  • 2 campaigns (both single player and in coop)

    • German vs Soviet Union - Kursk (Operation Citadel) in 1943

    • Soviet Union vs German - Kursk (Operation Citadel) in 1943

  • 38 missions (both single player and in coop) including:

    • 20 German skirmish scenarios

    • 6 Soviet skirmish missions

    • 12 procedural missions

  • 23 vehicles, including 19 tanks, armored vehicles and self-propelled guns

    • PzKpfw VI Tiger Ausf. H1

    • PzKpfw VI Tiger Ausf. E (Mid)

    • PzKpfw V Panther Ausf. A

    • Sd.Kfz. 251/1 Ausf. C

    • Sd.Kfz. 251/2 Ausf. C (Mortar)

    • PzKpfw VIII Maus

    • PzKpfw IV Ausf. H

    • PzKpfw III Ausf. M

    • PzKpfw KW-1S(r)

    • PzKpfw. KW-1B 755(r)

    • PzKpfw. KW-1B 756(r)

    • PzKpfw. KW-1C 756(r)

    • PzKpfw T-34 747(r)

    • PzKpfw T-70 743(r)

    • StuG 40 Ausf. G

    • Opel Blitz

    • KV-1 mod 1941

    • KV-1 mod 1942

    • KV-1S

    • T-34/76

    • T-70

    • ZiS-5

  • 16 static guns

    • 8.8 cm Flak 18

    • 2 cm Flakvierling 38 (AA)

    • 15 cm Nebelwerfer 41

    • 8 cm Granatwerfer 34

    • Static MG-42

    • 5 cm Pak 38

    • 7.5 cm Pak 40

    • 82 mm BM-37 Mortar

    • 85 mm M1939 (52-K)

    • 85 mm air defense gun M1939

    • 37 mm M1939 (61-K)

    • 37 mm automatic air defense gun M1939

    • 152 mm howitzer M1938 (M-10)

    • M-42 45mm AT gun

    • ZIS-3 AT gun

    • MG Maxim

  • German, Soviet troops

    • Wehrmacht (including tank crews)

    • Waffen SS (including tank crews)

    • Red Army (including tank crews)

  • Unlimited options to customize & apply camouflage patterns, change the side numbers and emblems on vehicles

  • Vehicles have parts and modules that require repair

  • Interact with tank exterior and interior parts, the engine, fuel system and gearbox, the tracks and wheels

  • Replenish ammunition and refuel vehicles

  • Take the tank to the proving grounds, to have some fun with every vehicle in the game

data.short_description: Tank Squad is a tactical-combat action game. Take part in big tank battles during World War II. Play single-player or coop (4 players). Repair your tanks, replenish supplies, manage the crew and get back to the action!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Hungarian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB VRAM, GeForce GTX 570 / Radeon HD 6970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game supports DLSS and FSR upscaling algorithms. If you're experiencing low FPS and your GPU supports any of these algorithms - try them out. Game loads much faster on SSD, HDD sometimes cause the game to freeze while loading the game and require restart (after restart the game loads correctly). If you're experiencing crashes while loading - it might be that the game takes up too much RAM - to quickly fix it you can lower the Texture Quality setting.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel I7 (11 generation), AMD Ryzen 9 5900
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM (GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD RX 7900 GRE), a GPU that supports DLSS or FSR upscaling filter
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game supports DLSS and FSR upscaling algorithms. If you're experiencing low FPS and your GPU supports any of these algorithms - try them out. Game loads much faster on SSD, HDD sometimes cause the game to freeze while loading the game and require restart (after restart the game loads correctly). If you're experiencing crashes while loading - it might be that the game takes up too much RAM - to quickly fix it you can lower the Texture Quality setting.

content_descriptors.notes: The violence/brutality that we want to add to the game is that the infantry/soldiers bodies can be dismembered (after, for example, an artillery shell or a bomb explodes near that soldier), or be burnt (with flame thrower). This game will be a grim and realistic depiction of horrors of war.
